channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Camilo cobra checagem de fatos em tempo real no debate da Globo entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: Camilo Santana, campaign coordinator for Lula, called for real-time fact-checking during the TV Globo debate between Lula and Flávio. He emphasized the importance of combating misinformation during the televised debate.

item.title: Lula vai pedir anulação da candidatura de Flávio por "interferência" da Meta
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) requested the annulment of Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential candidacy, accusing Meta of improper interference in the electoral process. The move was announced on Tuesday (20) as part of Lula's strategy to challenge political opponents.

item.title: Kotscho: Flávio tem muito a explicar, e nada será esclarecido se eleito
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has many explanations to give about the revenue of his law office, and the investigation may not proceed if he is elected, according to columnist Ricardo Kotscho on UOL News.

item.title: MPF investiga suposta intimidação a manifestantes em atos anti-Lula no RN
item.description: The Federal Public Ministry (MPF) has opened an investigation following a disturbance at an anti-Lula rally in Rio Grande do Norte, where protesters were allegedly intimidated at federal educational institutions. The action aims to investigate possible incidents of hostility against the rally participants.

item.title: Bruno Engler diz que pode ser eleito presidente da ALMG: "Sem a esquerda"
item.description: Bruno Engler (PL) stated he can be elected president of ALMG without left-wing support, emphasizing center-right majority. He mentioned discussions with the caucus and potential alliances, including with Doorgal Andrada (PP). Engler participated in an event supporting Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Perse para shows x Rouanet: entenda as diferenças entre os programas de incentivo à cultura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) proposes restoring Perse, a tax incentive program for the events sector, highlighting differences with the Rouanet Law, which supports cultural projects through income tax exemptions. Perse was terminated in 2025 after reaching the $15 billion cap and facing suspicions of irregularities such as money laundering and misuse of benefits. The Rouanet Law, already in place, reached a record fundraising of $3.41 billion in 2025.

item.title: PT diz ter 100 assinaturas por CPMI contra Flávio por Dark Horse e advogado
item.description: The PT leads an initiative with over 100 parliamentarians, including support from PSD, PSB and Podemos, to establish a CPI investigating the financing of the film 'Dark Horse' and the relationship between Flávio Bolsonaro and Willer Tomaz. The strategy aims to pressure the opponent during the campaign and promote transparency, while Lula proposes opening bank secrecy in the TV debate. The opposition also seeks support for a CPI on Fábio Luís Lula and Roberta Luchsinger.

item.title: Lula pede que idosos façam do voto uma “questão de honra”
item.description: Lula urged elderly voters to treat voting as a 'matter of honor' in the runoff and called for mobilizing those who did not vote in the first round. During Northeast rallies, he emphasized national sovereignty, criticized U.S. subordination, and highlighted regional initiatives like the São Francisco river transposition. He also challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to disclose his bank and phone records.

item.title: Marçal diz que eleitor de Renan Santos ‘põe o voto onde quiser’
item.description: Pablo Marçal, an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro, stated in a podcast that Renan Santos' voters can cast their ballots wherever they want, after Santos decided not to endorse any candidate. The remark sparked discussion about electoral alliances.

item.title: Tropa do Flávio cobra Rubel após vídeo de Nikolas perder áudio
item.description: The Flávio Troop, a support group for Flávio Bolsonaro, mobilized supporters to criticize singer Rubel after the audio of a video by federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira was removed, allegedly at his request to Sony. The video, which garnered over 83 million views, used the song 'Grão de Areia' by Rubel and Xande de Pilares, and featured testimonials from Northeast residents about challenges under President Lula's government. Nikolas publicly questioned Rubel’s actions, accusing him of silencing voices supportive of the PT.

item.title: Itamaraty repudia declarações de Milei e fala em “ingerência externa”
item.description: Itamaraty rejected Argentine President Javier Milei's statements about the Brazilian elections, calling them unacceptable and an attempt at foreign interference. Milei labeled Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as a 'left-wing thief' and suggested possible fraud in the electronic voting system, without providing evidence. The Brazilian government reaffirmed that the country's electoral system is secure and monitored by international observers.

item.title: MG: mercado é proibido de trocar uniformes vermelhos por camisas da Seleção
item.description: The Minas Gerais Labor Public Ministry filed a lawsuit against a market in Capinópolis that required employees to switch from red uniforms to yellow Brazilian Team shirts during the first round of the 2026 elections, a practice deemed indirect electoral harassment. The court granted an urgent injunction prohibiting the use of political symbols in the workplace and ordered the company to pay R$150,000 in collective moral damages.

item.title: “A vida dele é podre”, diz Lula sobre Flávio não abrir sigilo
item.description: President Lula challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to release his banking and phone records, calling his life 'rotten' and accusing him of dishonesty. Lula filed a request with the TSE to break Flávio's seals, conditional on reciprocity. The request includes data from companies linked to both candidates, including an offshore firm in Portugal.

item.title: Rubel acionou Sony para tirar áudio de nordestinos anti-Lula, diz Nikolas
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira accused singer Rubel of requesting Sony to remove audio used in a video featuring testimonies from northeasterners critical of President Lula. The claim lacks independent confirmation, and the restriction may have stemmed from automatic Instagram copyright mechanisms. The controversy sparked mobilization of Flávio Bolsonaro's supporters online.

item.title: Flávio x Lula: saiba quando saem as últimas pesquisas antes do 2º turno
item.description: Seven opinion polls for the 2026 presidential runoff will be released from October 21 to 24, measuring the race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The surveys show mixed results, with Flávio leading at 52% in Real Time Big Data and Lula reaching 51% in Vox Brasil. The election takes place on October 25.

item.title: Lula lidera o debate presidencial sobre segurança pública nas redes
item.description: In the final stretch before the runoff, Lula leads the presidential debate on public security on social media with 5.99 million interactions, surpassing Flávio Bolsonaro (3.61 million). Lula's profile also leads among influencers, with 5.9 million interactions in just seven posts.

item.title: Mãe de Luciano Huck desabafa e relembra ameaças de morte ao filho gay
item.description: Marta Dora Grostein, mother of Luciano Huck, shared an emotional message about her son Fernando Grostein, who had to leave Brazil in 2019 due to death threats related to his sexual orientation. She emphasized the importance of family support for the LGBTQIA+ community.

item.title: Com áudio barrado, Nikolas cobra Rubel: "Covarde, calou voz de nordestinos"
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) fiercely criticized singer Rubel after the campaign audio for Flávio Bolsonaro had its music blocked by Sony Records. Nikolas accused Rubel of cowardice for preventing the use of the song 'Grão de Areia,' stating 'nobody else asked' for the blockage. He emphasized the importance of Northeast voices in the campaign and urged the producer to release the content.

item.title: Itamaraty diz que Milei tenta interferir nas eleições brasileiras
item.description: Itamaraty condemned Argentine President Javier Milei's comments on the Brazilian elections as an unacceptable attempt at foreign interference, defending the Brazilian electoral system. Milei called President Lula a thief and criticized the electronic voting system, but the ministry denied any irregularities. The statement also linked Milei's remarks to claims previously made by Jair Bolsonaro after the 2022 elections.

item.title: Flávio quer retomar Perse, que teve custo de R$ 50 bi
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) proposed reviving Perse, a program that cost R$ 50 billion and was marked by irregularities. In 2024, under Lula, the program was terminated after exceeding the R$ 15 billion cap and amid suspicions of money laundering and overbilling.

item.title: Campanha de Lula lança site contra “censura” da Meta
item.description: Lula's campaign launched a website to collect complaints about censorship by Meta, submitting a report to the TSE to ensure fair competition against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio tira do X posts em que criticava o Bolsa Família
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro deleted X posts in which he criticized Bolsa Família, a social program he linked to vote-buying. The removal was identified by O Estado de S. Paulo and the senator is running for president against Lula in the second round on Sunday, the 25th.

item.title: Dez romarias reconhecidas por lei federal: a cidade que teve um padre como primeiro prefeito e abrigou a editora de cordel mais importante do Brasil
item.description: Juazeiro do Norte, in the Cariri region of Ceará, became the focus of federal recognition by incorporating ten traditional pilgrimage festivals into the national tourism calendar in 2026, highlighting its century-old history intertwined with politics, popular poetry, and woodcut printing. The city, which had a priest as its first mayor, hosts the most important cordel publishing house in Brazil and draws pilgrims nearly year-round.

item.title: Projeto de Damares quer impedir gastança de recurso público em ano eleitoral
item.description: Senator Damares Alves proposed an amendment to the Electoral Code and Election Law to prohibit the granting of economic and fiscal benefits during the election year, creating a new electoral crime with sentences of 1 to 4 years imprisonment and preserving exceptions such as existing public policies and emergency situations.

item.title: Flávio parabeniza Cleitinho por não ficar "quietinho" após pedido de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro praised Minas Gerais' elected governor Cleitinho Azevedo for not complying with Lula's call for neutrality in the runoff, calling the president resentful. At an event, Flávio claimed Lula had threatened not to carry out works in Minas if Cleitinho supported his campaign. Cleitinho did not comment on the accusation but reaffirmed his support for the bolsonarist candidate.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE analisa representações da campanha de Flávio
item.description: The TSE reviews PL representations alleging premature campaign advertising linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the Unha e Carne operation, targeting figures like Boulos and Gleisi. A separate case questions a supposed 7x0 shift schedule tied to the senator.

item.title: Ibovespa valoriza mais de 1% com vantagem de Flávio Bolsonaro em novas pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: The Ibovespa rose 1.57%, reaching 208,200 points, driven by polls showing a technical edge for Flávio Bolsonaro over Lula, encouraging investors to shift from the dollar to riskier assets. Banks like Bradesco and Itaú led gains, while the dollar fell to R$ 5.02. The market awaits clarity ahead of Friday's election.

item.title: Itamaraty trata declarações de Milei sobre processo eleitoral como 'inaceitáveis' e 'desequilibradas'
item.description: Itamaraty condemned Argentine President Javier Milei's statements about Brazil's electoral process as unacceptable and unbalanced, accusing him of interfering in democracy and spreading false information from defeated supporters. The Brazilian government reiterated the security of electronic voting and stated that the decision on the country's future lies solely with the Brazilian people.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: A guerra contra a Meta e a frustração dos petistas com Felca
item.description: The Antagonist Chat episode discussed President Lula's lawsuit at the TSE against Meta, accusing algorithmic manipulation in favor of Flávio Bolsonaro. It also covered influencer Felca's video, which frustrated PT supporters. The topic reflects recent tensions in the electoral and digital landscape.

item.title: Mano Ferreira: Especialistas consideram abrupta transição do Bolsa Família
item.description: Experts cited by Mano Ferreira view the Bolsa Família transition as abrupt, whether under the current one-year model or the two-year proposal from Flávio Bolsonaro's team (PL). The rule provides for an immediate cutoff of benefits without a gradual phase, according to analysis on Pulso Político at Canal UOL.

item.title: Janones é recebido por apoiadores ao ter alta hospitalar e compara Lula a Messi
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) was received by supporters after being discharged from the Vila Nova Star Hospital in São Paulo, where he was admitted for cardiac arrhythmia. During the event, he compared President Lula to football player Lionel Messi, sparking political reactions.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira publica relatos de nordestinos sobre pobreza e falta de oportunidades
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) released a video featuring testimonies from Northeast residents about poverty, lack of access to medications and water, and limited job opportunities. The content criticizes the federal government of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and highlights youth migration from the region in search of employment. The publication aims to raise public awareness about regional inequalities in Brazil.

item.title: Prefeitura de SP confirma vazamento de dados de 58.000 câmeras
item.description: The São Paulo City Hall confirmed a data leak from the Smart Sampa surveillance system, which monitors over 58,000 cameras, but denied platform security failures. The incident, attributed to an employee under investigation, exposed sensitive data for 11 months. Mayor Ricardo Nunes defended the system as secure, while the report revealed access to images from schools and hospitals.

item.title: Vídeo: TSE pede que eleitor confira endereço de sua seção eleitoral
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Court (TSE) reports that 554 polling stations changed locations between the first and second rounds, mostly due to weather-related damages. Voters can check their updated voting location through the TSE website or the e-Título app.

item.title: Lula lidera engajamento nas redes em todo o 2º turno, com 200 milhões de interações
item.description: Lula led social media engagement during the 2026 election runoff, reaching 200 million interactions—three times more than Flávio Bolsonaro (54 million). The analysis by Projeto Brief shows a reversal from the first round, where Flávio dominated most metrics.

item.title: TV CELULAR | O BRASIL VAI VENCER 19/10/2026
item.description: Political promotional video supporting Brazil, released in the context of the 2026 elections. Contains digital campaign elements but does not directly mention specific candidates.

item.title: Por agenda, Lula prevê ato do transporte gratuito para quinta
item.description: President Lula postponed the Planalto Palace event to Thursday (22) to submit a PEC establishing free public transport on weekends to the National Congress. The initiative is part of measures announced by his government and campaign during the final stretch of the election race.

item.title: Flávio à frente de Lula, pressão do TSE sobre a Meta e debates: as últimas notícias da eleição ao vivo
item.description: Young voters express their preferences and concerns for the 2026 elections, highlighting the influence of social media and the difficulty in distinguishing truth from misinformation. The content reflects movement in the race, mentioning figures like Flávio and Lula, and calls for TSE pressure regarding Meta.

item.title: Meta diz ao TSE que adotou revisão humana em bloqueios a perfis de campanha
item.description: Meta reported to the TSE that it has adopted human review for blocking campaign ads on its platforms. The measure responds to a requirement from the Brazilian electoral court, which has been pressing the company to enhance transparency and oversight of political content. Meta did not disclose details about the number of profiles affected or the impact of the new policy.

item.title: TSE determina que Nikolas Ferreira e Pablo Marçal não publiquem conteúdos já vetados
item.description: The TSE prohibited Nikolas Ferreira and Pablo Marçal from publishing previously censored content on social media, reinforcing digital control over the electorate. The decision aims to ensure compliance with electoral regulations and prevent misinformation on social platforms.

item.title: Novo pede cassação de Lula após pacotão eleitoreiro do PT
item.description: The Novo party filed an Electoral Judicial Investigation Action (AIJE) requesting the annulment of Lula and Alckmin's ticket over alleged irregularities in economic benefit measures. The action seeks an eight-year ban from running for office for both. The case will be analyzed by the TSE.

item.title: Real Time Big Data: maioria aprova promessas de Lula e Flávio que aumentam gastos públicos
item.description: Most voters support public spending promises from Lula and Flávio, including expanded Farmácia Popular with exams (74%) and five new federal prisons (82%). Infrastructure and security proposals also gain broad backing, even among opponents' supporters. The poll does not provide cost or funding details.

item.title: Janones avisa no Exército do Lula que terá alta nesta 3ª feira
item.description: Federal congressman André Janones (Rede-MG) announced via the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula' that he will be discharged from Vila Nova Star Hospital at 1:13 PM, symbolically referencing the PT's number. Hospitalized in the ICU for cardiac arrhythmia after the presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, he reported being clinically stable and plans to hold a live broadcast with supporters on upcoming campaign steps.

item.title: Promessa de Flávio aumenta prazo de proteção a beneficiários do Bolsa Família de 18 meses para dois anos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposed extending from 18 to 24 months the Bolsa Família Beneficiary Continuity Benefit protection period, allowing families who obtain formal employment or start their own business to maintain half of the assistance for a longer time. The measure aims to provide financial security during the economic transition and provides for automatic return to the program if the new income is not consolidated. The proposal was presented by Daniella Marques, coordinator of the economic area of the campaign.

item.title: A pergunta incômoda que a guerra de Trump impõe a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Trump's war in the Middle East has raised oil prices, affecting Brazil both as an exporter and consumer. Both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will face the need to maintain or revise fuel subsidies, but Flávio offers no clear proposals to address the international inflationary impact.

item.title: Governo Lula projeta falta de recursos a partir de 2028
item.description: The Lula administration (PT) warns of a fiscal crisis starting in 2028, after mobilizing 300 billion reais in 2026 for social benefits, and proposes a gradual fiscal adjustment to Congress to prevent cuts to public policies.

item.title: Após supostas regalias, Milton Leite é transferido de cadeia na Grande SP
item.description: Former councilman Milton Leite (União) was transferred from Mogi das Cruzes Prison amid allegations of prison privileges. He is detained on suspicion of involvement in a PCC scheme with bus companies. The 'Custody (Un)Feal' operation led to arrests, search warrants, and the seizure of R$155,000.

item.title: Vicentinho tem 52% contra 48% de Dorinha no 2º turno no TO
item.description: A Real Time Big Data survey released on October 20, 2026 shows federal deputy Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) leading with 52% of valid voting intentions against Senator Professor Dorinha (União Brasil) at 48% in the Tocantins gubernatorial runoff. The poll surveyed 1,600 voters from October 15-19, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Willer Tomaz apostou R$ 4,8 milhões em bet acusada de lavar dinheiro do PCC
item.description: Lawyer Willer Tomaz, linked to former senator Flávio Bolsonaro, wagered R$4.8 million at Bet7K, accused of money laundering for the PCC. The Federal Police's 'Narco Bet' operation in November 2025 investigates alleged money laundering through online games and cryptocurrency transfers. Tomaz is also under investigation for R$1.4 billion in transactions at Blaze betting house, claiming gambling addiction to recover funds.

item.title: PM promete investigar policias que liberaram bolsonarista que socou mulher
item.description: The São Paulo Military Police opened a preliminary investigation into officers who released a man who assaulted a woman at the Butantã Metro station. The attacker, identified as Diogo Freire through a viral video, had participated in a pro-Flávio Bolsonaro rally and previously faced a court order for threats.
